name: Pan-Seared Ribeye-Style Sirloin with Garlic Butter
steps: Sear the seasoned steak 3 to 4 minutes a side.
Baste with butter, garlic and thyme; rest and slice.
Serve with roasted asparagus.

name: Peppercorn Steak with Mushroom Sauce
steps: Crust the steak in cracked pepper and sear.
Brown the shallot and mushrooms, add broth and cream and reduce.
Spoon over the sliced steak.

name: Flat Iron Steak Fajitas
steps: Marinate and sear the steak; slice.
Sauté the peppers and onion in oil with a little seasoning.
Serve in warm tortillas with avocado and lime.

name: Greek Beef Bowls with Cucumber Tomato Salad
steps: Brown the beef with oregano and garlic.
Toss the cucumber, tomato and onion with lemon.
Build bowls over quinoa with feta.

name: Italian Beef Braciole-Style Roll-Ups
steps: Pound the steak thin and layer with spinach, parmesan, garlic and pine nuts; roll and tie.
Brown, then braise in the marinara 65 minutes.
Slice and serve with basil.

name: Oven-Roasted Beef Tenderloin with Herbed Yogurt
steps: Rub the beef with oil, garlic and rosemary and roast at 425°F to medium rare, about 30 minutes.
Stir the yogurt with mustard and chives and serve alongside.

name: Beef and Cauliflower Rice Stuffed Peppers
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and cumin; mix with the cauliflower rice and tomatoes.
Fill the peppers, top with mozzarella and bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Lean Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry with Cashews
steps: Toss the sliced steak in arrowroot and sear in oil.
Stir-fry the vegetables with garlic and ginger.
Combine with soy sauce and cashews.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Mustard Pan Sauce and Green Beans
steps: Sear and roast the pork at 400°F for 14 minutes; rest.
Soften the shallot in the pan, add broth, mustard and thyme and reduce; swirl in butter.
Slice the pork and serve with the sauce and steamed beans.

name: Slow Cooker Pork Chili Verde
steps: Combine everything but the cilantro in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 7 hours, shred and finish with cilantro.

name: Ham and Navy Bean Soup
steps: Combine everything in a pot and simmer 55 minutes, mashing some beans.

name: Smothered Pork Chops with Cabbage
steps: Sear the paprika-rubbed chops; set aside.
Soften the onion and cabbage in the pan, add broth thickened with arrowroot and vinegar.
Return the chops and simmer 15 minutes.

name: Garlic Rosemary Lamb Chops with Roasted Eggplant
steps: Rub the chops with garlic, rosemary and oil; sear 3 minutes a side.
Roast the eggplant with oil at 425°F for 18 minutes.
Finish with lemon.

name: Turkey Bacon Cheeseburger Salad
steps: Cook the beef patties and crumble; crisp the bacon.
Build the salad with lettuce, tomato, pickle, onion and cheddar.
Dress with yogurt stirred with mustard.

name: Cheeseburger Casserole with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Brown the beef with the onion.
Mix with the cauliflower rice, tomatoes, mustard, pickle and egg in a dish.
Top with cheddar and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Spicy Pork Sausage and Kale Soup
steps: Brown the sausage with the onion and garlic.
Add the broth, beans and pepper flakes and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the kale for the last 5.

name: Beef Burrito Skillet with Rice and Beans
steps: Brown the beef with the seasoning.
Add the tomatoes, beans, corn and cooked rice and heat through.
Top with cheddar to melt.

name: Pork Souvlaki Rice Bowls
steps: Marinate the pork cubes in lemon, oregano, garlic and oil and grill.
Serve over rice with cucumber, tomato and yogurt.

name: Glazed Meatballs with Pineapple and Peppers
steps: Mix the meats, egg, oat bran and garlic and shape meatballs; bake 18 minutes at 400°F.
Simmer the pineapple, peppers, soy sauce, vinegar and arrowroot into a glaze and toss.

name: Mushroom Swiss Burger Bowls
steps: Cook the beef into patties and slice.
Sauté the mushrooms and onion.
Serve over lettuce and tomato with Swiss and mustard.

name: Teriyaki Pork Stir-Fry with Snap Peas
steps: Sear the sliced pork in oil.
Stir-fry the vegetables with garlic and ginger.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar and arrowroot and serve over rice.

name: Taco Beef and Black Bean Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Bake the sweet potatoes.
Brown the beef with the seasoning and beans.
Split the potatoes and fill; top with cheddar, salsa and cilantro.

name: Brats with Peppers and Onions over Cabbage
steps: Brown the sausages in oil.
Add the peppers, onion and cabbage and cook until tender.
Finish with mustard and vinegar.

name: Lamb and Spinach Stew with Chickpeas
steps: Brown the lamb with the onion and garlic.
Add the spices, tomatoes, chickpeas and water and simmer 70 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and lemon.

name: Borscht with Beets and White Beans
steps: Simmer the beets, carrot, onion and broth 25 minutes.
Add the cabbage and beans and cook 12 minutes.
Finish with vinegar and serve with yogurt and dill.

name: Hungarian Beef Goulash with Paprika
steps: Brown the beef and soften the onion with the paprika.
Add the pepper, tomatoes and broth and simmer 90 minutes.
Serve with a spoon of yogurt.

name: Chicken Paprikash with Cauliflower
steps: Brown the chicken, soften the onion and pepper with the paprika.
Add the broth and simmer 25 minutes; stir in the yogurt.
Serve over roasted cauliflower.

name: Kielbasa-Style Turkey Sausage with Sauerkraut and Potatoes
steps: Brown the sausage in oil.
Add the onion, apple, potatoes and sauerkraut with a splash of water and cook covered 20 minutes.
Serve with mustard.

name: Stuffed Cabbage Roll Soup
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and garlic.
Add the cabbage, sauce and broth and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the cooked rice.

name: Polish Mushroom and Barley Soup
steps: Soften the vegetables, add the barley and broth and simmer 35 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream and dill.

name: Pork Schnitzel, Baked with Almond Crumb
steps: Pound the pork thin, dip in egg then almond flour and parmesan and bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 18 minutes.
Shred the cabbage with vinegar for a quick slaw.
Serve with lemon.

name: German-Style Potato Salad with Mustard Vinaigrette
steps: Boil and slice the potatoes.
Whisk the mustard, vinegar and oil; toss with the warm potatoes, bacon, onion and chives.

name: Red Cabbage with Apples
steps: Soften the onion in butter, add the cabbage, apple, vinegar and cinnamon.
Cook covered 25 minutes.

name: Irish-Style Lamb and Vegetable Stew
steps: Brown the lamb, then simmer with the vegetables, thyme and broth 75 minutes.
Add the potatoes and cook 15 minutes more.

name: Colcannon with Kale
steps: Mash the potatoes with warm milk and butter.
Fold in the wilted kale and green onion.

name: Corned Beef and Cabbage Skillet
steps: Brown the onion and potatoes in butter.
Add the cabbage and a splash of water and cook until tender.
Fold in the sliced meat and mustard.

name: Swedish-Style Turkey Meatballs with Yogurt Gravy
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, oat bran and onion and shape meatballs; bake 18 minutes.
Thicken the broth with arrowroot and stir in the yogurt.
Serve over boiled potatoes.

name: Gravlax-Style Salmon with Dill Yogurt
steps: Serve the salmon on rye with cucumber slices.
Top with yogurt stirred with dill and lemon.

name: Open-Faced Egg and Smoked Salmon Rye Toast
steps: Spread the toast with cream cheese.
Top with soft egg, salmon, capers and dill.

name: Noodle Kugel, Lightened
steps: Cook the noodles.
Mix the cottage cheese, yogurt, eggs, cinnamon, vanilla, sugar and diced apple and fold in the noodles.
Bake in a dish at 350°F for 45 minutes.

name: Chicken Matzo Ball Soup Without Matzo
steps: Simmer the chicken and vegetables in the broth 30 minutes; shred the chicken.
Mix the egg and almond flour into small dumplings and poach in the broth 12 minutes.
Return the chicken and finish with dill.

name: Shakshuka-Style Eggs in Tomato and Pepper Sauce on Rye
steps: Simmer the onion, pepper, paprika and tomatoes 10 minutes.
Poach the eggs in the sauce.
Serve with rye toast and parsley.

name: Tuna Melt Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Hollow the tomatoes.
Mix the tuna with yogurt, celery and mustard and fill.
Top with cheddar and bake at 400°F for 12 minutes.

name: Pierogi-Style Cabbage and Potato Bake
steps: Cook the onion and cabbage in butter until soft.
Mash the potatoes with the cottage cheese.
Layer in a dish and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes; finish with dill.

name: Hearty Lentil and Sausage Stew, German-Style
steps: Brown the sausage with the vegetables.
Add the lentils, broth and bay and simmer 30 minutes.
Finish with vinegar.

name: Creamy Cucumber Dill Salad
steps: Slice the cucumber and toss with the yogurt, dill, onion and vinegar.

name: Beet and Goat Cheese Salad with Walnuts
steps: Slice the cooked beets over the arugula.
Dress with vinegar and oil and top with goat cheese and walnuts.

name: Hasselback Sweet Potatoes with Herbs
steps: Slice the sweet potatoes almost through at intervals.
Brush with oil, garlic and rosemary and roast at 400°F for 45 minutes; top with parmesan.

name: Turkey and Cranberry Wrap with Spinach
steps: Spread the tortillas with cream cheese.
Layer turkey, spinach, apple and cranberries and roll.

name: Steak and Arugula Sandwich with Horseradish Yogurt
steps: Sear and slice the steak.
Spread the toast with yogurt mixed with mustard and pile on steak, arugula and onion.

name: Grilled Eggplant and Mozzarella Sandwich
steps: Grill the sliced eggplant.
Layer on the bread with pesto, mozzarella, tomato and basil and press.

name: Open-Faced Chicken Avocado Toast with Egg
steps: Toast the bread and top with avocado, shredded chicken and a fried egg.

name: Greek Salad Pita Pockets with Chickpeas
steps: Toss the chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, feta and olives with lemon and oil.
Stuff the pitas.

name: Crab Salad Lettuce Wraps
steps: Mix the crab with celery, yogurt, lemon, Old Bay and chives.
Spoon into lettuce leaves.

name: Egg Salad Wraps with Spinach and Tomato
steps: Hard-boil and chop the eggs and mix with yogurt and mustard.
Roll in the tortillas with spinach and tomato.

name: Chicken Pesto Caprese Sandwich
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Layer on toasted bread with pesto, mozzarella, tomato and arugula.

name: Loaded Veggie Hummus Wrap
steps: Spread the tortillas with hummus and layer the vegetables and feta; roll.

name: Barbecue Pulled Turkey Sandwich with Slaw
steps: Poach and shred the turkey and toss in a sauce of paste, vinegar and paprika.
Mix the slaw with the yogurt.
Pile on the buns.

name: Tuna and White Bean Salad Sandwich
steps: Mix the tuna, mashed beans, onion, lemon, oil and parsley.
Spread on the bread.

name: Italian Chicken Sausage Sandwich with Peppers
steps: Grill the sausages.
Sauté the peppers and onion with the marinara.
Serve on toasted buns.

name: Southwest Chicken Salad with Cilantro Lime Yogurt
steps: Season and grill the chicken; slice.
Arrange the vegetables and beans.
Blend the yogurt, lime and cilantro for a dressing.

name: Salmon Salad with Dill and Cucumber
steps: Flake the salmon and mix with the yogurt, dill, lemon and onion.
Serve over greens and cucumber.

name: Grilled Peach and Arugula Salad with Feta
steps: Grill the peach halves.
Toss the arugula with balsamic and oil and top with peach, feta and pecans.

name: Chopped Greek Chicken Salad with Lemon Oregano Dressing
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Chop the salad vegetables and toss with the lemon, oil and oregano.
Top with chicken, olives and feta.

name: Edamame and Carrot Slaw with Ginger Dressing
steps: Boil the edamame and cool.
Toss with the shredded carrot and cabbage and a dressing of vinegar, sesame oil, soy sauce and ginger.

name: Warm Lentil Salad with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Roast the vegetables with half the oil at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Toss with the warm lentils, arugula, vinegar and remaining oil.

name: Turkey Taco Salad Cups
steps: Brown the turkey with the seasoning.
Fill lettuce cups and top with tomato, cheddar, avocado and salsa.

name: Spinach Salad with Eggs, Mushrooms and Mustard Dressing
steps: Boil and slice the eggs.
Toss the spinach, mushrooms and onion with the mustard, vinegar and oil.
Top with the eggs.

name: Shrimp and Mango Salad with Lime
steps: Poach the shrimp.
Toss the greens, mango, avocado and onion with lime, oil and cilantro and top with shrimp.

name: Quinoa Chickpea Salad with Cucumber and Herbs
steps: Toss everything with the lemon and oil.

name: Tuna Salad Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Mix the tuna with celery, yogurt, mustard and lemon.
Fill the halved peppers.

name: Chicken Waldorf-Style Salad Cups
steps: Mix the chicken, apple, celery, walnuts, yogurt and lemon.
Spoon into lettuce cups.

name: Roasted Broccoli and Cauliflower with Lemon Tahini
steps: Roast the vegetables with the oil at 425°F for 22 minutes.
Drizzle with tahini whisked with lemon, garlic and water.

name: Parmesan Crusted Roasted Tomatoes
steps: Halve the tomatoes and top with garlic, parmesan and oil.
Roast at 400°F for 22 minutes and finish with basil.

name: Chili Lime Roasted Sweet Potato Wedges
steps: Toss the wedges with oil and chili powder and roast at 425°F for 28 minutes.
Finish with lime and cilantro.

name: Garlic Butter Green Beans and Mushrooms
steps: Sauté the mushrooms in butter with garlic.
Add the blanched beans and cook 3 minutes; finish with parsley.

name: Sesame Garlic Bok Choy
steps: Sauté the garlic in sesame oil, add the bok choy and soy sauce.
Cook 4 minutes and top with seeds.

name: Tomato Cucumber Avocado Salad
steps: Toss everything with lime and oil.

name: Baked Parmesan Asparagus Fries
steps: Dip the spears in egg, then almond flour and parmesan.
Bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: Cinnamon Roasted Butternut Squash Cubes
steps: Roast the cubed squash with oil, cinnamon and salt at 425°F for 28 minutes.
Top with pecans.

name: Garlic Herb Brown Rice
steps: Warm the cooked rice with garlic softened in oil.
Fold in parsley and lemon.

name: Sauteed Zucchini and Yellow Squash with Basil
steps: Sauté the squash and garlic in oil 8 minutes.
Finish with basil and parmesan.

name: Marinated Cucumber and Onion Salad
steps: Slice the vegetables and toss with the vinegar, dill and sweetener.
Chill 30 minutes.

name: Baked Apple Slices with Cinnamon and Oats
steps: Toss the sliced apples with cinnamon and place in a dish.
Top with oats, butter and walnuts and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Chocolate Dipped Banana Bites
steps: Slice and freeze the banana.
Dip in melted chocolate and sprinkle with walnuts.

name: Ricotta Parfait with Peaches and Almonds
steps: Layer the sweetened ricotta with sliced peaches.
Top with almonds and cinnamon.

name: Strawberry Cheesecake Overnight Chia
steps: Whisk the milk, cream cheese, chia and vanilla and chill overnight.
Top with strawberries.

name: Peanut Butter Protein Brownies
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Bake in a lined pan at 350°F for 22 minutes.

name: Orange Almond Flour Cake Bites
steps: Whisk the eggs, zest and juice with the sweetener and vanilla.
Fold in the almond flour and baking powder.
Bake in a mini tin at 350°F for 16 to 18 minutes.

name: Frozen Berry Yogurt Cups
steps: Stir the sweetened yogurt with crushed berries.
Spoon into cups, top with almonds and freeze 3 hours.

name: Cocoa Almond Butter Energy Balls
steps: Mix everything, roll into twelve balls and chill.

name: Spiced Rooibos Iced Tea with Orange
steps: Steep a strong spiced tea, chill, and add the orange and stevia.

name: Pineapple Spinach Yogurt Smoothie
steps: Blend everything with ice.

name: Vanilla Almond Milk Latte
steps: Froth the warmed almond milk with vanilla and sweetener.
Pour over the coffee.

name: Blackberry Basil Sparkler
steps: Muddle the berries with basil and lime.
Top with sparkling water over ice.

name: Mocha Protein Smoothie
steps: Blend everything with ice.

name: Warm Cinnamon Vanilla Milk
steps: Warm the milk with cinnamon, vanilla and sweetener and whisk.

name: Cucumber Mint Green Smoothie
steps: Blend everything with ice.

name: Raspberry Almond Milk Shake
steps: Blend with ice.

name: Peanut Butter Cup Protein Shake
steps: Blend with ice.

name: Smoky Roasted Garlic White Bean Mash
steps: Roast the garlic until soft.
Mash with the beans, oil, paprika and lemon and finish with parsley.

name: Protein-Packed Egg White Veggie Scramble
steps: Sauté the vegetables in oil.
Add the egg whites and scramble; top with feta.

name: Pumpkin Spice Oatmeal with Pecans
steps: Simmer the oats with the milk, pumpkin and spice.
Top with pecans.

name: Smoked Salmon and Avocado Egg Cups
steps: Fill muffin cups with salmon, avocado and cream cheese.
Pour in the eggs and bake at 350°F for 16 minutes; finish with chives.

name: Whole Grain Toast with Cottage Cheese and Tomato
steps: Toast the bread and top with cottage cheese, tomato, basil and pepper.

name: Turkey Sausage Egg and Cheese Breakfast Bites
steps: Brown and crumble the sausage.
Mix with the eggs, milk, cheddar and spinach and bake in mini muffin cups at 350°F for 18 minutes.

name: Coconut Chia Breakfast Pudding with Mango
steps: Whisk the chia, coconut milk, vanilla and sweetener; chill 4 hours.
Top with mango.

name: Banana Almond Butter Toast
steps: Toast the bread and spread with almond butter.
Top with banana, chia and cinnamon.

name: Southwest Egg Skillet with Sweet Potato and Black Beans
steps: Soften the diced sweet potato, pepper and onion in oil with cumin.
Add the beans, make wells and cook the eggs in them covered 6 minutes.

name: Cinnamon Apple Protein Pancakes
steps: Whisk the eggs and yogurt, fold in the oat flour, protein, cinnamon, baking powder and grated apple.
Cook small pancakes.

name: Spinach and Gruyere-Style Breakfast Strata
steps: Layer the cubed bread, spinach, onion and Swiss in a dish.
Pour over the eggs and milk and bake at 350°F for 35 minutes.

name: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
steps: Whisk the ricotta, eggs and lemon.
Fold in the oat flour and baking powder; cook small pancakes and top with blueberries.

name: Egg and Black Bean Breakfast Tostadas
steps: Crisp the tortillas in the oven.
Top with warm beans, fried eggs, avocado, salsa and cotija.

name: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken with Zucchini Ribbons
steps: Marinate the chicken in lemon, thyme, garlic and oil; grill.
Sauté the zucchini ribbons briefly and top with parmesan.

name: Chicken and Vegetable Kebabs with Tzatziki
steps: Skewer the marinated chicken with the vegetables and grill.
Serve with yogurt mixed with grated cucumber.

name: Sheet Pan Turkey Sausage with Broccoli and Sweet Potato
steps: Toss everything with oil and garlic powder on a tray.
Roast at 425°F for 25 to 28 minutes.

name: Chicken Cutlets with Arugula Tomato Salad
steps: Coat the pounded chicken in egg then almond flour and parmesan and pan-fry in half the oil.
Toss the arugula and tomatoes with lemon and remaining oil and pile on top.

name: Peanut Chicken Skewers with Cucumber Salad
steps: Marinate the chicken in peanut butter, soy sauce, lime and ginger and grill on skewers.
Toss the cucumber and onion with vinegar.

name: Mediterranean Turkey Burgers with Tzatziki
steps: Mix the turkey with feta, oregano and garlic and shape patties; grill.
Serve on lettuce with tomato and cucumber yogurt.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Taco Soup
steps: Combine everything in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 6 hours and shred the chicken.

name: Turkey and Sweet Potato Chili
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion and garlic.
Add the spices, sweet potato, beans, tomatoes and broth and simmer 30 minutes.

name: Roasted Garlic Cauliflower Soup
steps: Roast the cauliflower and garlic with the oil at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Blend with the broth and milk.

name: Spring Vegetable and Chicken Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken, carrot and leek in the broth 18 minutes; shred the chicken.
Add the asparagus and peas for 5 minutes and finish with dill and lemon.

name: Italian White Bean and Tuna Soup
steps: Soften the garlic in oil, add the broth, beans and tomatoes and simmer 12 minutes.
Fold in the tuna and spinach.

name: Lemon Garlic Baked Tilapia with Roasted Broccoli
steps: Bake the tilapia with garlic butter and lemon at 400°F for 14 minutes.
Roast the broccoli alongside.

name: Salmon and Vegetable Foil Packets
steps: Seal the salmon and vegetables with oil, lemon and dill in foil packets.
Bake at 400°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Tuna Steak Tacos with Mango Salsa
steps: Sear the tuna 90 seconds a side and slice.
Mix the mango, onion, lime, cilantro and jalapeno.
Serve in warm tortillas.

name: Cajun Catfish Bowls with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Season and sear the catfish.
Sauté the pepper and cauliflower rice in oil.
Serve topped with fish, green onion and lemon.

name: Seared Scallops with Lemon Spinach
steps: Sear the dried scallops in butter 2 minutes a side.
Wilt the spinach with garlic and lemon and serve under the scallops.

name: Crispy Baked Shrimp with Cocktail Sauce
steps: Dip the shrimp in egg then almond flour, parmesan and paprika and bake on a tray at 425°F for 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir the paste with lemon for a quick cocktail sauce.

name: Chickpea and Spinach Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Bake the sweet potatoes.
Sauté the chickpeas and spinach with cumin and garlic.
Fill the potatoes and drizzle with lemon tahini.

name: Tofu Veggie Fried Rice, Brown Rice
steps: Brown the tofu, add the vegetables and garlic, scramble in the egg.
Add the cold rice, soy sauce and sesame oil.

name: Mushroom and Spinach Stuffed Zucchini Boats
steps: Scoop the zucchini and sauté the flesh with the mushrooms, spinach and garlic.
Mix with ricotta, fill the boats, top with parmesan and bake at 400°F for 22 minutes.

name: Three-Bean Salad Bowls with Quinoa
steps: Toss the beans, quinoa, onion and pepper with vinegar and oil.
Chill 30 minutes.

name: Roasted Vegetable Frittata Cups
steps: Divide the vegetables among muffin cups.
Pour in the beaten eggs and parmesan and bake at 375°F for 22 minutes.

name: Black Bean Quinoa Burrito Bowls
steps: Warm the quinoa, beans and corn.
Top with avocado, salsa, lime and cilantro.

name: Baked Chicken Tenders with Mustard Yogurt Dip
steps: Coat the chicken strips in egg then almond flour, parmesan and paprika and bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 16 minutes.
Stir the yogurt and mustard for dipping.

name: Mini Turkey Burger Sliders on Lettuce
steps: Shape twelve mini patties and sear 4 minutes a side.
Serve in lettuce leaves with tomato, pickle and mustard.

name: Cheesy Chicken and Broccoli Quesadillas
steps: Fill half of each tortilla with chicken, chopped steamed broccoli and cheddar and fold.
Crisp in a pan 2 minutes a side and serve with salsa.

name: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos
steps: Roast the sweet potato cubes with cumin.
Warm the beans and tortillas and fill with potato, beans and avocado; finish with lime and cilantro.

name: Pesto Chicken Zucchini Boats
steps: Scoop the zucchini halves.
Fill with shredded chicken mixed with pesto and tomatoes, top with mozzarella and bake at 400°F for 22 minutes.

name: Garlic Shrimp Tacos with Avocado Crema
steps: Sear the garlicky shrimp in oil.
Blend the avocado, yogurt and lime into a crema.
Fill the tortillas with shrimp, cabbage and crema.

name: Greek Chicken and Rice Skillet with Spinach and Feta
steps: Brown the chicken and garlic.
Add the cooked rice, broth, oregano and lemon and heat 8 minutes.
Fold in the spinach and top with feta.

name: Beef and Broccoli Cauliflower Rice Bowls
steps: Sear the sliced steak and set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli, garlic and ginger; add the cauliflower rice.
Return the steak with soy sauce and sesame oil.

name: Italian Stuffed Mushroom Caps with Turkey Sausage
steps: Remove the mushroom stems and chop.
Brown the sausage with the stems and garlic, mix with the cream cheese and parmesan.
Fill the caps and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

name: Greek Yogurt Chicken Salad Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Hollow the tomatoes.
Mix the chicken with yogurt, celery, dill and lemon and fill.

name: Turkey Meatball and Spinach Stuffed Peppers
steps: Mix the turkey, spinach, garlic and parmesan.
Fill the halved peppers and top with marinara.
Bake at 375°F for 35 minutes.

name: Cabbage and Ground Turkey Egg Roll Bowls
steps: Brown the turkey with garlic and ginger.
Add the slaw and soy sauce and cook 6 minutes; finish with sesame oil and green onion.

name: Spaghetti Squash with Turkey Marinara
steps: Roast and shred the squash.
Brown the turkey with the onion and simmer in the marinara.
Serve over the squash with parmesan and basil.

name: Garlic Parmesan Roasted Chickpeas
steps: Dry the chickpeas and toss with oil and seasoning.
Roast at 400°F for 25 minutes and toss with parmesan.

name: Egg Muffin Cups with Bell Pepper and Feta
steps: Divide the chopped pepper, spinach and feta among greased cups.
Pour in the eggs and bake at 375°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Tomato and Mozzarella Omelet with Basil
steps: Cook the beaten eggs in oil.
Fill with tomato, mozzarella and basil and fold.

name: Sausage, Egg and Cheese Roll-Ups on Tortillas
steps: Scramble the eggs with the crumbled sausage.
Fill the tortillas with the egg mix and cheddar and roll; serve with salsa.

name: Hearty Minestrone with Italian Sausage
steps: Brown the sausage with the vegetables.
Add the tomatoes, beans, broth and seasoning and simmer 20 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook until tender.

name: Lemon Chicken Orzo-Style Soup with Spinach
steps: Simmer the chicken and carrot in the broth 15 minutes; shred.
Add the pasta and cook until tender, then the spinach, lemon and dill.

name: Southwest Egg Roll Skillet with Ground Chicken
steps: Brown the chicken with the spices.
Add the slaw, beans and corn and cook 7 minutes.
Top with cheddar and lime.

name: Almond Butter Banana Oat Muffins
steps: Mash the banana and mix with the almond butter, eggs and milk.
Fold in the oats, baking powder and cinnamon.
Bake in a lined tin at 350°F for 20 minutes.

name: Bell Pepper and Ground Turkey Taco Boats
steps: Brown the turkey with the seasoning.
Fill the pepper halves, top with cheddar and bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.
Serve with salsa and avocado.

name: Chilled Cucumber Yogurt Soup with Dill
steps: Blend the cucumber, yogurt, garlic, dill, lemon and oil until smooth.
Chill and serve topped with walnuts.
